description: Check up to 20 rows of EU VAT numbers in EU VIES, row for row; a malformed or non-EU row is judged locally (`not_covered`, never `invalid`). UNKNOWN COSTS NOTHING, and the balance must cover the whole call (20 credits for 20 rows) before it runs. Optional requesterVatId adds a consultation number registered to you; a requester VIES refuses costs nothing. 1 credit (EUR 0.01) per answered row; needs a bearer token.

requesterVatId.description: Your OWN EU VAT number with country prefix (e.g. BE0403170701). Never stored.

rows.description: The list: 1 to 20 rows per call.

reference.description: Your own label for the row — a customer number, a name. It is echoed back, never interpreted.

vatId.description: The VAT number as written, WITH its two-letter country prefix, e.g. "BE0400378485" or "NL 8558.76.323.B01".

name: check_vat_list
